label: HEALTHY
exact_meaning: Service or subsystem is connected and within expected health bounds
notes: Used for monitor, backend, and soak health with slightly different semantics

label: READY
exact_meaning: Boring operational state with prerequisites aligned
displayed_in: startup control plane; operational readiness; strategy status
notes: Can mean startup-ready, paper-runtime-ready, or strategy-status-ready

label: BLOCKED
exact_meaning: Hard stop; action must not proceed
displayed_in: operational readiness; bridge preflight; lane statuses
notes: Overloaded across startup, paper, live, and bridge outcomes

label: WATCH
exact_meaning: Advisory review item; notable but not inherently blocking
notes: Recently caused false runtime blocks when treated like blocking faults

label: REVIEW
exact_meaning: Operator attention requested
notes: More of a workflow state than a gate

label: DEGRADED
exact_meaning: State is usable but not ideal
displayed_in: backend/source labels; runtime posture; soak health
notes: Sometimes advisory, sometimes used in gating

label: KILL_CANDIDATE
exact_meaning: Poor-performing strategy lane marked for scrutiny
notes: Name sounds terminal, but visibility remains important and trading may continue in some contexts

label: PAUSED
exact_meaning: Strategy or lane intentionally halted
notes: Clear hard stop

label: DISABLED
exact_meaning: Strategy or feature is administratively off
notes: Clear hard stop

label: STALE
exact_meaning: Payload or data freshness is beyond tolerance
displayed_in: runtime freshness; broker freshness; snapshot warnings
notes: Must be separated from WAITING_FOR_NEXT_DECISION_BAR

label: UNCLASSIFIED
exact_meaning: Fine-grained phase labeler could not classify the current sub-session
notes: Can coexist with valid broad session eligibility

label: WAITING_FOR_NEXT_DECISION_BAR
exact_meaning: Lane is loaded, session-eligible, and waiting for next completed decision bar
notes: Normal for 3m lanes between completed bars

label: NO_SETUP
exact_meaning: Recently evaluated and no qualifying setup is present
notes: Needs separation from unavailable/blocked

label: ACTIONABLE
exact_meaning: Trade intent exists on current decision bar
notes: Should be split into ENTRY vs EXIT in operator explanations

label: ACTIONABLE_NOW
exact_meaning: BUY/SELL/EXIT signal exists and lane is submit-ready on this bar
blocks_paper: yes when absent only for immediate submit
blocks_live: yes when absent only for immediate submit
notes: Strict and momentary; not the same as broadly open-to-trade

label: DECISION_WITHOUT_INTENT
exact_meaning: A decision cycle ran but no standardized intent was recorded
notes: Historically confused with active runtime failure

label: BLOCKED_NOT_SENT_TO_BROKER
exact_meaning: Runtime generated a trade event that failed bridge/routing before broker submit
displayed_in: runtime route audits; recent fill diagnostics
notes: Important distinction from local fills or broker rejects

label: ELIGIBLE_TO_TRADE
exact_meaning: Lane is loaded, flat, session-eligible, route-ready, and broadly tradable
notes: Name overlaps with operator expectation of 'available to trade' while still stricter than session eligible

label: SESSION_ELIGIBLE_NO_SETUP
exact_meaning: Lane is in allowed session and evaluated but currently has no setup
notes: Useful operator state

label: LOADED_NOT_ELIGIBLE
exact_meaning: Lane is loaded but some condition prevents immediate broad eligibility
notes: Needs finer breakup by reason

label: FAULTED
exact_meaning: Strategy/runtime fault is active
notes: True hard stop

label: RECONCILING
exact_meaning: State mismatch or recovery is still unresolved
notes: Often recoverable but should fail closed

label: INFORMATIONAL_ONLY
exact_meaning: Condition is visible but non-blocking
notes: Good candidate to keep as advisory-only

label: LOADED_CONFIG_ONLY
exact_meaning: Lane is configured but not present in active runtime
notes: Important inventory/runtime distinction

label: PAPER_RUNTIME_BLOCKED
exact_meaning: Paper runtime is attached but not operational
notes: Should remain paper-only wording

label: LIVE_TRADE_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED
exact_meaning: Live-specific authority is unavailable
notes: Previously conflated with paper block

label: PAPER_TRADE_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED
exact_meaning: Paper-specific authority stack is unavailable
notes: New clearer top-level paper concept
